title: 13 Qualified Meetings for a GCC Recruitment Specialist
challenge: A recruitment company specialising in Global Capability Centres wanted to connect with organisations building or expanding GCC teams in India.
solution: Myntmore developed a focused ICP covering GCC leaders, HR heads, engineering leaders and business decision-makers. We built content around talent availability, hiring complexity and GCC scaling challenges, supported by targeted LinkedIn outreach.
results: Stronger presence among the GCC talent ecosystem.
